deliverables.exit_criteria: gate validate contract-traceability green.

deliverables.exit_criteria: docs/ reorganized; doc-catalog green under the new tree.

deliverables.exit_criteria: clean series builds the masterplan; old series archived; no dangling ADR refs.

deliverables.description: Automated ADR authoring pipeline: best-practice-research -> planning-and-task-breakdown/ralplan/plan -> consensus -> ADR (generative template), wired as a governed workflow.
deliverables.exit_criteria: an ADR can be produced end-to-end by the pipeline; the ADR carries an evidence[] block citing research + a consensus record.

deliverables.description: Propagation engine: an accepted ADR regenerates the masterplan + every artifact named in its affected_surfaces (trickle-down).
deliverables.exit_criteria: `oya gen propagate <ADR>` regenerates masterplan + affected_surfaces; idempotent.

deliverables.description: Propagation drift gate: every affected_surfaces artifact is consistent with the ADRs that drive it (committed == regenerated).
deliverables.exit_criteria: gate fails when an affected doc is hand-edited out of sync with its ADR.

deliverables.description: ADR-provenance gate: a planning_impact ADR must cite best-practice-research evidence + a consensus record; no ADR bypasses the pipeline.
deliverables.exit_criteria: gate fails an ADR missing evidence[]/consensus provenance.

deliverables.description: Door-classification autonomy gate: `door: two-way` ADRs auto-merge on green; `door: one-way` require founder sign-off (the agent autonomy boundary).
deliverables.exit_criteria: merge automation honors door; one-way ADR cannot auto-merge.

deliverables.description: COE->gate flywheel: every incident/agent-failure Correction-of-Error must terminate at a missing gate/spec/automation and emit a new gate (never 'human/agent error').
deliverables.exit_criteria: COE template + gate rejecting a human-error root cause; each COE links a new/updated gate.

deliverables.description: Ownership-sharding: a single-threaded owner-agent per service/lane owning disjoint paths; concurrent-safe-paths admission prevents two lanes editing the same path.
deliverables.exit_criteria: owner declared per service in catalog; admission gate rejects overlapping concurrent claims.

deliverables.description: High-throughput merge path: merge-queue speculative rebase (ADR-0111) + affected-targets + two-tier presubmit(fast/affected/blocking) vs postsubmit(full + regression attribution).
deliverables.exit_criteria: concurrent green PRs serialize through the queue without manual rebase; postsubmit bisects the culprit on a break.

deliverables.description: Self-repair loop: deterministic auto-fix (fmt, rebase, regenerate drifted docs via ADR-0365 propagation, quarantine flaky tests, draft COE->gate); escalate to human ONLY for one-way-door / non-deterministic / unrepairable.
deliverables.exit_criteria: a protocol violation is auto-detected and auto-repaired end-to-end with no human step in the deterministic cases; escalation only otherwise.

deliverables.description: Anti-waste / anti-thin-scaffold gates: PR-FAQ before a new service exists; Definition-of-Done completion gate (tests+docs+ADR+SLO+evidence) so 'green' means substance, not scaffold.
deliverables.exit_criteria: a new service without a PR-FAQ is blocked; a half-done change fails DoD.

deliverables.description: Quality/resilience gates: automated canary analysis (Kayenta-style statistical judge on Argo Rollouts), chaos GameDay (SLO-gated), error-budget policy + promotion freeze.
deliverables.exit_criteria: promotion is statistically gated; over-budget freezes non-critical promotion; a chaos experiment runs SLO-gated.

deliverables.description: DORA four-keys instrumented from evidence/audit-chain + ArgoCD events (deploy freq, lead time, change-fail rate, MTTR) — the throughput/quality measurement.
deliverables.exit_criteria: `oya dora` emits the four keys from real pipeline events.

deliverables.description: Trusted-runner-signed evidence: the farm/Jenkins re-executes every gate hermetically and signs results (SLSA provenance + cosign); the author-agent's self-reported evidence is never trusted.
deliverables.exit_criteria: merge gate verifies a trusted-runner signature over the gate results; an unsigned/self-reported evidence file is rejected.

deliverables.description: Separation of duties: the adversarial reviewer-agent is a CI stage powered by the Intelligence service (distinct identity from the author); its APPROVE/REJECT is posted as the trusted-runner-signed oya-pr-review status — the verdict itself is trustless, not a self-reported approval.
deliverables.exit_criteria: reviewer identity != author; the oya-pr-review APPROVE is a trusted-runner signature (not an agent self-report); a self-reviewed changeset is rejected.

deliverables.description: Verified-changeset gateway: merge is automatic on signed-green + independent-APPROVE via the merge-queue / Forgejo auto-merge — no human-PR-review ceremony.
deliverables.exit_criteria: a changeset auto-merges only when both signals are present; neither alone suffices.

deliverables.description: Reproducibility / re-execution: evidence is re-derived in a hermetic sandbox, not copied from the author's working tree; flaky/non-reproducible evidence is quarantined.
deliverables.exit_criteria: the trusted runner reproduces the author's claimed result from clean checkout; divergence blocks merge.

deliverables.description: Ownership-sharding conflict prevention: one owner-agent per service on disjoint flat paths (ADR-0362), enforced by concurrent-safe-paths admission + CODEOWNERS auto-routing.
deliverables.exit_criteria: two concurrent lanes touching the same path are rejected at admission; CODEOWNERS routes review to the owner.

deliverables.description: Stacked-diff authoring on plain git: agents author small (<~200 LOC) dependent units as a ghstack-style chain of Forgejo PRs (base = parent's branch). NOT jj.
deliverables.exit_criteria: a stack of dependent PRs lands incrementally; each entry is independently gate-verified.

deliverables.description: The trustless-gateway as a single required status check (the binding gate, NOT Forgejo's merge button — it has merge-despite-failed-checks races): green only when trusted-runner-signed evidence (ADR-0367) AND independent reviewer attestation both verify against the PR head SHA.
deliverables.exit_criteria: auto-merge fires only when the signed check is green; a forced merge with the check red is structurally impossible (the check is the gate).

deliverables.description: Speculative stack-aware merge-train (LATER; ADR-0363 §3 concurrency trigger): adopt gitea-mq/bors-class queue that tests the projected post-merge state, batches, bisects on failure, speculates in parallel. Adopt, do not reinvent.
deliverables.exit_criteria: at concurrency, semantic conflicts do not reach trunk; per-PR latency stays near the single-CI floor.

deliverables.description: Maximum-agent deployment: the fleet is kept at maximum safe concurrency at all times, fed by the masterplan (the generated collection of plans/tasks from ADRs).
deliverables.exit_criteria: an orchestrator deploys the max safe number of owner-agents against open masterplan deliverables; idle capacity is an alert.

deliverables.description: Self-improving: every failure becomes a new gate (COE->gate flywheel, ADR-0366); the gate corpus monotonically grows; repeat failures are impossible.
deliverables.exit_criteria: each COE links a new/updated gate; a regression that recurs without a new gate fails the flywheel check.

deliverables.description: Self-healing: deterministic protocol violations are auto-repaired (ADR-0366 self-repair) without human/agent intervention.
deliverables.exit_criteria: deterministic violations auto-repair end-to-end; only one-way/non-deterministic/unrepairable escalate.

deliverables.description: Self-governing: every step is a gate (ADR-0364/0365/0366/0367); nothing relies on agent or human discipline; the system enforces itself.
deliverables.exit_criteria: no protocol step is bypassable; ungated mutation paths fail the meta-audit.

deliverables.description: Human input is architecture-only: agents own everything except architectural decisions (ADRs). Human-touch on non-architecture merges is an exception that must be justified.
deliverables.exit_criteria: merges carry no required human step except where door:one-way demands founder sign-off; human edits to generated/agent-owned artifacts are flagged.

deliverables.description: Even architecture is challenged: every ADR (including founder-authored) flows through best-practice-research + adversarial consensus review; an anti-pattern or a better hyperscaler alternative is surfaced and BLOCKS acceptance until reconciled.
deliverables.exit_criteria: the adr-challenge gate fails an ADR with an unaddressed anti-pattern or a cited better-alternative; the founder's ADRs are not exempt.
